content: Independent invariant/deviation enumeration for D2 pattern 2 (confidence-calibration-loop port from dan_research_karpathy_wiki). INVARIANTS TOUCHED: (1) Sanitize-at-trust-boundary - audit reads agent-authored findings.summary/raw_excerpt; must stay display-only, never into a shell/prompt/eval sink. (2) Never-expose-raw-DB-errors - wrap sqlite, emit type(exc).__name__ only + generic msg. (3) Principle#2 capture-automatic - the calibration RUN must itself be logged (calibration_log.jsonl). (4) Principle#4 independence - human reviewer IS the independent evaluator; proposals must carry raw evidence (sample findings), not just aggregate metrics. (5) Principle#7/Prime-Objective - proposals NEVER auto-applied; classifier surfaces write-protected; queue is a status:pending COMMUNICATION artifact, not an instruction file. (6) ADR-0022 is_noise - every severity query MUST filter WHERE is_noise=0 (noise rows carry unmaintained severity) + regression-test it. DEVIATIONS from wiki: human-gated proposal queue vs wiki auto-propose; deterministic read-only script vs wiki LLM re-read; signals=confidence_calibration+is_noise+marker-vs-heuristic vs wiki MEDIUM-routings+user-redirects (false_positive sparse - scope accordingly); classifier surface split classifier-code (extract_findings patterns) vs skill-rubric (severity-calibration) => different approval paths; advisory not gate-integrated; append-only queue. RISK: confidence_calibration is a ROUGH proxy (|conf_avg - unique/(unique+dup)|) - flag low-confidence proposals, conservative thresholds. VERDICT: sound to proceed to ADR+impl with 3 non-negotiables baked in.

ACCEPTED the independent enumeration (verified against ADR-0022 is_noise coupling, the trust-boundary regression class, Principle#7, and the confidence_calibration formula in compute_agent_effectiveness.py). 3 non-negotiables baked into ADR-0024 + impl: (A) enforcement vs autonomous self-application - classifier surfaces (scripts/extract_findings.py patterns + .claude/skills/severity-calibration/SKILL.md) treated as write-protected for agent edits; proposal queue is status:pending communication artifact under memory/calibration-proposals/, never an instruction file; (B) WHERE is_noise=0 on every severity query + regression test; (C) report carries raw evidence (sample findings) behind each proposal. Port shape: read-only scripts/audit_calibration.py + Calibration Loop section in autonomous_workflow.md (named donor_target) + tests + FRAMEWORK_CHANGELOG. Independent enumeration done by sonnet independent-perspective per CRITICAL MITIGATION (orchestrator did NOT self-enumerate).

STEWARD GATE: APPROVE 0.90. Verified 'never auto-applies' 3 ways (working tree: classifier surfaces unmodified; code writes only queue+log; tests lock it). Honors Principle #7/#8/#4/#2 + Prime Objective (wiki attribution; refuses extraction). Rule wording strong enough vs future autonomous self-apply. Non-blocking: settings.json write-protect draft-diff (defense-in-depth, parked); optional BUILD_STATUS pointer; developer merge still the Principle-7 gate.

SECURITY /review: APPROVE 0.95. All 5 properties hold (cited lines): no execution sink for agent-authored finding text (display-only, repr-quoted); SQL parameterized; DB errors wrapped -> only type(exc).__name__; writes only queue+log (no self-apply); clock-derived queue filename (no traversal). Severity: low - Markdown queue must stay human-read never machine-parsed (folded to ADR-0024 residual risks).

QA /review: 0.82. Severity: blocking - is_noise test proved only negative direction (a blanket filter would also pass); needs co-presence positive test. FOLDED: added test_is_noise_filter_is_precise_not_blanket (asserts 10/10 not 10/15). Also folded non-blocking: regex error-format assertion, MIN_SAMPLE boundary tests x2, classifier-unavailable note test. Tests 11->15 all pass.

SYNTHESIS: APPROVE 0.88 (REV-20260613-170043). 1 blocking (QA is_noise co-presence) FOLDED + 3 cheap non-blocking wins folded + security LOW doc note folded. Steward 0.90, security 0.95, qa 0.82->resolved. ADR-0024 status->accepted. Advisories carried: settings.json write-protect draft diff (parked), BUILD_STATUS pointer (optional), NULL-summary/all-noise belt-and-suspenders (next cycle), developer merge = Principle-7 gate, education deferred (auth E).
